pride_data.title: Identification of protein-protein interaction mediated by N-myristoylated proteins using photocrosslinkable clickable myristoylation probes X3 and X10
pride_data.projectDescription: HeLa cells were treated with myristoylation probes X3 and X10, which incorporate both alkyne and diazirine moieties. Cells were then treated with NMT ihibitor IMP-366 (DDD85464) or DMSO vehicle and UV-irradiated before lysis. The experiment identifies myristoylated proteins through comparison of vehicle and NMT inhibitor treated samples. A number of non-myristoylated proteins were enriched together with myristoylated proteins indicating possible photocrosslinked protein interactors.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: For X10 probe: HeLa cells were grown in R10K8 SILAC media supplemented with 10% SILAC FCS for at least 5 passages. Cells were treated with X10 (100 μl), UV-irradiated and lysed after 24 h. Heavy lysate was used as spike-in.  HeLa cells in light (R0K0) media were treated with X10 (100 μM) for 24 h with or without the addition of 1 μM of IMP-366 (DDD85646) NMT inhibitor, each treatment regimen in triplicate. Cells were UV-irradiated and lysed in 0.1% SDS, 1% Triton X-100, Roche Complete protease inhibitors, phosphate-buffered saline. 200 μg of heavy spike-in was added to 400 μg of each light lysate. Myristoylated proteins carrying alkyne through labelling with X10 were ligated to AzRB regent using Cu-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition.The lysates were enriched on streptavidin-agarose beads. Samples were reduced with TCEP, alkylated with IAA and digested with trypsin. The samples were desalted on a STAGE-tip. Peptides were separated on nano-LC column and detected using Thermo QExactive. For X3 probe: The experiment was performed identically, using X3 probe instead of X10.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Proteomics results (*.RAW files) were processed using MaxQuant 1.5.5.1 using the latest release of Homo sapiens proteome from uniprot.org. In MaxQuant, digestion was set as Trypsin/P, oxidation (M) and acetylation (N-term) were set as variable modifications, carbamidomethylation (C) was set as fixed modification and other settings were as by default.  Perseus 1.5.5.3 was used to analyze file proteinGroups.txt obtained as result of MaxQuant searches. Potential contaminants, reverse and only identified by site proteins were discarded before the analysis. All data was transformed using log2(x) function before any further manipulation. Data was normalized by subtracting a median of each data column.
